name: Simple Customer CSV Exporter for WooCommerce
author: wpgenie2

sections.description:
Simple Customer CSV Exporter for WooCommerce provides an easy and efficient solution for exporting customer data with flexible filtering options based on purchase history.

This plugin empowers administrators to generate targeted customer lists filtered by specific purchased products or customers who have never placed an order. Exported data is delivered in clean CSV format, ideal for email marketing, customer segmentation, data analysis, or outreach campaigns. The plugin supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) to ensure compatibility with modern WooCommerce installations.

Features

  • Filter customers by specific purchased products
  • Identify customers with no order history
  • Export filtered customer lists to CSV format
  • Full WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility
  • Simple, user-friendly interface with minimal setup
  • Clean CSV output ready for import into marketing or CRM systems
  • Enables quick and precise customer segmentation for marketing efforts

Use Cases

  • Create targeted email campaigns based on product purchases
  • Identify customers for product announcements and updates
  • Segment customers for re-engagement or loyalty programs
  • Export inactive customers (no orders) for cleanup or outreach
  • Build marketing lists tailored to specific campaigns
  • Analyze customer buying patterns for strategic planning

Support

You can contact us at our website wpgenie.org if you have problems or questions.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or greater

Setup

This section describes how to install Simple Customer CSV Exporter for WooCommerce plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. In wp-admin menu you will see entry WC Customers.
  4. Go to WC Customers, apply filter to list customers and use Export to CSV button to export users.

If you have any problems contact us at http://wpgenie.org/
sections.faq:
What is the purpose of this plugin? How can I use it?

Examples – export users who purchased specific product and add them to newsletter for that product, export users that did not purchase anything and mail them coupon code for first purchase. You can also export all users that purchase something and give them special discount.

Is WooCommerce mandatory for plugin to work?

Yes, plugin will not work without WooCommerce since it is coded for WooCommerce powered shops.

Have a question?

If you want answer here please send us your questions to info@wpgenie.org
